At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies.

Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request.

As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up.

If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations
Bengaluru, India

Drive the strategy and execution of our global procurement technology ecosystem. Our architecture leverages Zip (Zip HQ) as the premier intake and orchestration layer, integrated natively with Oracle Fusion Cloud as our financial system of record.
The ideal candidate is a Procurement technologist who understands the nuances of the entire Source-to-Pay (S2P) lifecycle. You will bridge the gap between user-centric intake and rigorous financial controls, ensuring that complex business requirements from Legal, Finance, and Global Sourcing are translated into seamless, automated workflows that maintain data integrity across both Zip and Oracle

End-to-End Process Architecture: Design and optimize the global S2P process, ensuring a frictionless hand-off between upstream sourcing/intake (Zip) and downstream purchasing/payables (Oracle Fusion).
Dual-Platform Configuration: Act as the functional lead for both Zip and Oracle Fusion Procurement. Build complex intake workflows in Zip while simultaneously configuring Requisitioning, Purchasing, and Supplier Portals in Oracle to match.
Integration Ecosystem Management: Own the functional health of the Zip-to-Oracle integration. Monitor data flow for Requisitions, Purchase Orders, and Supplier Master Data, Compliance screening, ensuring that "In-Flight" changes in one system are accurately reflected in the other.
Strategic Business Partnership: Lead discovery sessions with Global Procurement, Legal, and Accounting. Translate high-level business policies into precise logic within the tech stack.
Data Governance & Compliance: Ensure that the "System of Record" (Oracle) remains audit-ready. Manage the mapping of Category Codes, Cost Centers, and Tax attributes between the Zip UI and the Oracle GL.
Release Management: Manage the quarterly update cycles for both Zip and Oracle. Conduct impact assessments on new features to ensure no disruption to the integrated workflow.
AI Procurement Agent Strategy & Governance: Lead the adoption and functional governance of Oracle's embedded and custom AI agents (e.g., Procurement Policy Advisor), ensuring all AI-driven automation and outputs within the S2P process are compliant, auditable, and drive process efficiency across Zip and Oracle.
Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
Platform Proficiency: 8+ years of hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion Procurement (Self-Service Procurement, Purchasing, Supplier Model) and 1+ years of experience with Zip (Zip HQ).
Procurement Subject Matter Expertise: Deep understanding of the Source-to-Pay (S2P) lifecycle, including PR/PO lifecycle, 3-way matching, Encumbrance Accounting, and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM).
Integration Fluency: Proven experience managing API-based integrations between Intake-to-Procure tools and Tier-1 ERPs. You should understand how a Zip "Approval" translates into an Oracle "Approved Requisition."
Process Engineering: Ability to map complex, cross-functional business processes and identify opportunities for automation or bottleneck removal.
Systems Thinking: You don't just fix a field; you understand how changing a workflow in Zip impacts the General Ledger and AP downstream in Oracle.
Experience establishing technical standards and governing system changes in a live production environment.
Experience in an organization transitioning to Oracle Cloud Ecosystem.
Hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion Global Trade Management system..
Third-party supporting software experience like Ironclad, Navan, etc..
Exposure to the Data Center Infrastructure industry.
Relevant professional product/functional certifications (e.g., Oracle Cloud certifications)
Working knowledge of AI Agent Studio for Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications.
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Who we are
Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.
Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

We are seeking a results-driven professional passionate about the seamless execution of supply chain operations. In this high-impact role, you will bridge the gap between our US operations and our Taiwan-based Supply Chain team.

By collaborating with Material Management, Global Operational Engineering, WW Planning, and VMI partners, you will play a critical role in hitting supply targets and revenue goals. As a key US-based resource, you will ensure 24-hour continuity and provide essential SCM support during US business hours.
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the Western or Central United States (Pacific, Mountain, and Central Time Zones), capable of working hours adapted to the US daytime with a necessary overlap with the Taiwan team's early morning hours. This position requires travel up to 10% of the time.
Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.
This role is open to candidates residing in the US except the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.

Global Continuity & US Coverage: Serve as the primary US-based SCM representative to ensure seamless, 24-hour operational continuity, specializing in Inbound Supply, VMI operations, and HEM supply management.
End-to-End Supply Execution: Oversee inbound supply chain operations, including forecast releases, PR/PO processing, and logistics coordination, ensuring all shipments meet rigorous timeframes and revenue targets.
Production & Material Optimization: Provide critical insights into production capacity and material visibility while driving BOM ordering elasticity and MRD reporting to optimize supply with JDM partners.
Cross-Functional Bridge: cross-view the implementation of ECO changes and collaborate with suppliers and internal teams to resolve production gaps and alleviate supply constraints through proactive technical coordination.
Executive Communication: fluent communication and professional presentation skills to influence executive-level stakeholders.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Supply Chain & Fulfillment Expertise: 6+ years of experience in supply chain execution, including direct supplier management, material/manufacturing capacity planning, and refurbishment. Proficient in managing CTB (Clear to Build) reports, OPO backlog tracking, and material shortage mitigation.
Operational Systems & Technical Literacy: Strong working knowledge of ERP, PLM, and ASCP systems. Familiarity with hardware-specific processes like BOM management, Costing, and ECO is highly valued.
Strategic Reporting & Analysis: Proven ability to consolidate supply elasticity data and deliver high-level analytics to Executive leadership . Capable of translating complex task simulations into actionable solutions and formal presentations.
Cross-Functional collaboration: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of interacting cross-functional teams. Demonstrated ability to implement programs across diverse stakeholder groups and sponsor new process establishments.
Agile Project Management: Highly organized with a "passion for risk mitigation" and number sensitivity. Able to prioritize and delegate effectively within high-paced, high-growth environments to ensure program schedules are met.

Fluency in Mandarin (Traditional/Taiwanese) is a plus to international stakeholders.

Wer sind wir?
Entstanden sind wir aus Deutschlands größter Finanzbildungsorganisation. Über 250.000 jungen Menschen haben wir gezeigt, wie Finanzen wirklich funktionieren. Aus dieser Mission ist Finanzklar entstanden. Denn Wissen allein reicht nicht – die meisten Menschen scheitern nicht am Verstehen, sondern an der Umsetzung.
Genau hier setzen wir an: Wir helfen ganz konkret dabei, die richtigen Finanzentscheidungen zu treffen. Ohne Provisionslogik gegen den Kunden. Ohne undurchsichtige Produkte. Sondern mit echter, unabhängiger Beratung.
Unsere Mission: Gute Finanzentscheidungen dürfen nicht länger nur den Experten überlassen sein – wir demokratisieren sie.
Und dafür suchen wir dich. Als Media Buyer entscheidest du mit darüber, ob Menschen Finanzklar überhaupt kennenlernen. Wir suchen dafür jemanden, der nicht einfach Anzeigen schaltet, sondern versteht warum manche Kampagnen Menschen bewegen und andere nicht.
Aufgaben
Du planst, schaltest und optimierst unsere Meta-Ads-Kampagnen – von der Zielgruppe über das Budget bis zur täglichen Auswertung der Zahlen. Parallel entwickelst du die Creatives dazu: Anzeigenbilder, Videos und Texte, die unsere Botschaft transportieren. Du bringst zwei Dinge zusammen: Du analysierst Zahlen und verstehst, was sie bedeuten – und du entwickelst daraus Bilder und Texte, die Menschen wirklich ansprechen. Deine Aufgaben im Detail:
Eigenständige Planung, Aufbau und Steuerung von Meta Ads Kampagnen (Facebook & Instagram) – von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung
Verwaltung und Optimierung von Werbebudgets mit klarem Fokus auf messbaren Ergebnissen (CPL, CTR, ROAS)
Entwicklung von Kampagnenstrategien auf Basis von Zielgruppenanalysen und Marktbeobachtung
Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Ad-Creatives – statisch und videobasiert – eigenständig oder in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team
Strukturiertes Testing von Zielgruppen, Creatives, Botschaften und Landingpages nach klarer Testlogik
Regelmäßige Analyse der Kampagnenergebnisse und Ableitung konkreter Optimierungsmaßnahmen
Erstellung verständlicher KPI-Reportings zur internen Auswertung und Weiterentwicklung der Strategie
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Gesamtmarketingstrategie von Finanzklar

Meta Blueprint Zertifizierung von Vorteil – aber kein Ausschlusskriterium
Sauberes, fehlerfreies Deutsch in Wort und Schrift – Pflicht

Gespür für visuelle Wirkung – du erkennst was Menschen anspricht und was nicht
Fähigkeit, Werbebotschaften klar und zielgruppengerecht zu formulieren
Grundkenntnisse in Design- oder Videotools (z.B. Canva, Adobe Express, CapCut) von Vorteil – oder die Bereitschaft, sie zu erlernen
Interesse an Storytelling und der Frage warum bestimmte Inhalte funktionieren und andere nicht

Hohe Eigenmotivation – du treibst dich selbst an, auch wenn niemand nachfragt
Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und Lernbereitschaft – du bist bereit, in kurzer Zeit viel aufzunehmen und anzuwenden
Strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise – du arbeitest präzise, dokumentierst sauber und hältst dich an definierte Prozesse
Offenheit für Feedback und Bereitschaft zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung
Teamfähigkeit – du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung und Team zusammen und kommunizierst proaktiv

Vollzeit oder Teilzeit – wir finden gemeinsam das Modell das passt
Ein Unternehmen mit echter Mission – du hilfst Menschen, bessere finanzielle Entscheidungen zu treffen

Chez HelloFresh, nous bousculons les habitudes alimentaires des français grâce à nos Box à cuisiner !
Notre ambition ? Révolutionner le quotidien de nos abonnés, en promouvant une façon plus durable de cuisiner et en leur faisant découvrir de délicieuses recettes, créatives et équilibrées. L’alliance parfaite entre technologie et gastronomie, pour un maximum de gourmandise.
HelloFresh est présent dans plus de 15 pays. La France, un jeune marché lancé en 2019, connaît une ascension fulgurante : nous y sommes déjà leaders depuis 2021. Le moment parfait pour rejoindre notre équipe et avoir un impact fort dans l'une des scales up françaises les plus prometteuses !
Comment rendre tout cela possible ? Grâce à une équipe talentueuse et dynamique, des valeurs fortes de bienveillance et de diversité, et un environnement de travail stimulant.
Les missions du poste
Pour notre jeune équipe de passionnés, nous sommes à la recherche d’un.e Responsable Supply Chain Site .

s.h: A- En tant que Responsable de l’équipe Supply Chain site
s.t:
Assurer un environnement de travail sûr et sain, visant le “zéro accident”
Manager les équipes: Réception, Entrepôt, Expédition, construire les plans de développement personnel, fixer les objectifs de performance, et accompagner les équipes pour y parvenir.
Superviser l’équipe Réception dont le rôle est de recevoir, compter, contrôler, et mettre à disposition de la Production les marchandises fraîches entrantes, en quantités exactes, aux emplacements prévus et en temps voulu
Superviser l’équipe Entrepôt dont le rôle est d’assurer la réception, le stockage et la mise à disposition des marchandises à longue conservation pour l’équipe de Production, en quantités exactes, aux emplacements prévus et en temps voulu
Superviser l’équipe Expédition dont le rôle est la gestion de l’entreposage et du dispatching des palettes de produits finis dans les délais impartis / gestion des déchets
Cadrer et optimiser les communications entre les équipes susmentionnées et les équipes FSQA (qualité), Procurement (achat et approvisionnement), et Production, pour assurer un démarrage de la production dans les meilleures conditions, chaque jour ; Être proactif et moteur dans la résolution des problèmes rencontrés
Gérer les niveaux de stock des marchandises à longue conservation et non-alimentaire ; travailler main dans la main avec l’équipe Procurement pour minimiser les pertes alimentaires
Mettre en place et optimiser les outils de suivi et de gestion de stock et mener des revues d’inventaires hebdomadairement et mensuellement en s’inspirant des pratiques existantes sur les autres sites HelloFresh
En collaboration avec le Responsable OPEX et le DA Production, fixer les objectifs de performances de votre équipe et concevoir la stratégie pour y parvenir
Mener une démarche d’amélioration continue basée sur les concepts de Lean Manufacturing

Être exemplaire en terme de sécurité au quotidien
Toujours placer la sécurité mentale et physique du personnel, ainsi que la qualité du produit, avant les impératifs de coût
Contribuer à créer un environnement de travail où l’excellence industrielle est atteinte sur le long terme en plaçant la sécurité et le bonheur au travail au centre des préoccupations au quotidien
Faire vivre les valeurs de HelloFresh sur le site
Participer à, et si nécessaire mener, les réunions de suivi production quotidiennes et hebdomadaires

Advanced Forecasting Tech: Familiarity with AI/ML forecasting tools, or a demonstrated curiosity and aptitude to learn them fast.

Manage tendering and contract awards for advanced client-supply Mechanical and Electrical infrastructure, including Air-conditioning units, power generating sets, diesel storage tanks, facility inverters, and roof-level solar panel solutions.

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

Rocket Lab’s Supply Chain team is responsible for the flow of all materials, products, and components throughout the business. With many of our own products functioning as critical components to our own and our customers’ missions, the Supply Chain team has a direct impact on the success of our rocket and satellite programs.

They set up assembly kits that enable our technicians to put together our Electron rockets, manage inventory, look after shipping and receiving, manage direct and indirect procurement, and inspect and ensure that all of our materials and products are compliant and up to standard.

They are the chain that links our teams together and are critical to our success.

Based on site at Rocket Lab’s Middle River, MD production facility, the Senior Logistics Coordinator is responsible for domestic and international shipping.

There are hundreds of components that are used to manufacture Electron’s Launch Vehicle that are globally sourced and/or moved domestically and internationally between Rocket Lab manufacturing sites. This role will actively manage the logistical movements of these items.

This role is responsible for managing domestic and international logistics from suppliers, between Rocket Lab locations internationally and beyond. The role also requires adherence to ITAR and other applicable export regulations.

Plan and coordinate inbound and outbound shipments to ensure timely delivery.
Schedule transportation and resolve shipping or delivery issues.
Ensure compliance with shipping regulations and maintain accurate documentation.
Identify and implement process improvements to optimize logistics operations.
Train, and support logistics staff to meet performance goals.
Build and maintain relationships with vendors and evaluate their performance.
Communicate with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth operations.
Track and analyze logistics KPIs and prepare performance reports.
Develop and implement risk management and contingency plans for disruptions.

High school diploma and 2+ years of experience.
Exposure to international shipping regulations.
High degree of knowledge of freight forwarding and customs regulations.
International Air Transportation Association, (IATA) / International Maritime Dangerous Good (IMDG) knowledge.
Strong IT knowledge, comfortable working with Windows.
Experience working with a fully integrated Enterprise Resource Planning system.
Basic understanding of necessary documentation for international shipping.

Als **Lead Buyer HLKS** übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Warengruppenstrategie in den Bereichen Heizung, Lüftung, Klima und Sanitär. Du bist eine erfahrene Fachperson mit fundierter Expertise im strategischen und operativen Einkauf im Bauumfeld und verantwortest die ganzheitliche Steuerung deiner Warengruppe über alle relevanten BKP-Positionen (CH).
Dein Fokus liegt auf der aktiven Mitgestaltung und Umsetzung einer zukunftsorientierten Warengruppenstrategie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Business Units. Dabei identifizierst du Marktpotenziale, entwickelst nachhaltige Beschaffungsstrategien und leistest einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur Optimierung von Kosten, Qualität und Lieferantenperformance.
Bist du ein Stratege, ein Verhandlungsexperte und tief in deiner Warengruppe verankert? Dann suchen wir dich!
Der Arbeitsort ist flexibel gestaltet und umfasst Einsätze am Hauptsitz in Opfikon sowie im Home-Office.
### Das bewegst du: ###
* In dieser Rolle bist du mitverantwortlich für die Umsetzung der Warengruppenstrategie im Bereich HLKS und arbeitest dabei eng mit dem Head Lead Buyer sowie den Vertretern der Business Units zusammen. Zudem verantwortest du in deiner Region die gesamte Warengruppe inklusive aller BKP-Positionen (CH) und treibst deren kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung voran.
* Du analysierst und steuerst die Risiken innerhalb der Warengruppe, erstellst Forecasts für Procurement und Business (u. a. zu Preisentwicklungen, kritischen Lieferanten und Lieferkettenrisiken) und stellst eine proaktive Risikofrüherkennung sicher.
* Dazu bündelst und koordinierst du die Projektbedarfe innerhalb deiner Warengruppe und stellst eine effiziente und strategisch ausgerichtete Bedarfsplanung sicher.
* Du verhandelst und schliesst Rahmenvereinbarungen mit strategischen Partnern ab und trägst aktiv zur Optimierung von Konditionen und Einkaufsstrukturen bei.
* Die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Projekten, Baustellen, Projektleitern und Niederlassungen bereitet dir Freude. Du übernimmst den operativen Einkauf, unterstützt die Kalkulation mit deinem Fachwissen und bringst deine Expertise frühzeitig in komplexe Projekte zur Optimierung von Kosten und Prozessen ein.
### Das bringst du mit: ###

s.t:
🏋️‍♀️ The Skinnify Story
Our founder Christian grew up in Frankfurt, Germany. Looking around, he noticed something striking: so many of the women in his life — his mom, his sister, his friends — wanted to get fitter, lose weight, and build muscle, but kept running into the same wall. They didn't have the time, the motivation, or the consistency to make the gym work.
The idea hit him during his own workout. He was using resistance bands and thought: what if these were built into everyday clothing? What if women could get the benefits of resistance training passively — while walking the kids to school, cooking dinner, or sitting at their desk? Fitness without the extra time or effort.
The idea was personal too. Christian was a difficult kid growing up and put his mom through a lot. She barely had time for herself, let alone the gym. He built Skinnify for women like her: busy, hardworking, often overlooked — so they could do something good for their bodies just by getting dressed.
🛍️ Our Products
What started with a single product — leggings with built-in resistance bands — has grown into a full collection of resistance-integrated clothing: leggings, sleeves, shoes, and more. We're on a mission to revolutionize how women do fitness by turning daily life into a workout.
🌟 Skinnify's Core Values
💡 Innovation – We design new, groundbreaking clothing with built-in resistance to revolutionize fitness.
🔥 Effectiveness – Our products help people burn more calories & get fitter with every step.
🌍 Accessibility – We make fitness accessible to everyone — even the busiest and least motivated.
🎉 Fun – We make exercise feel effortless and enjoyable.
✅ Quality – Our products are built to last — high-quality, durable, and reliable.

s.h: Our client is looking for a Logistics Coordinator.
s.t:
Our client operates within the international trade and logistics sector, supporting global supply chain operations through freight coordination, import/export documentation, and transportation management. Over the past several years, they have continued expanding their logistics capabilities while supporting customers across multiple international markets.
The Logistics Coordinator will play a critical role in managing ocean and air freight shipments from booking through final documentation. This position requires exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate effectively with carriers, warehouses, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to ensure smooth shipment execution.

Request and compare ocean and air freight quotations based on cost, transit times, routing options, and service levels.
Coordinate bookings with carriers, freight forwarders, warehouses, suppliers, and customers.
Monitor shipment progress and track key milestones from origin to destination.
Coordinate container loading schedules, pickups, and transportation logistics.
Review and verify Bills of Lading, Air Waybills, shipping instructions, and release documentation.
Prepare, review, and maintain export documentation, including Commercial Invoices, Packing Lists, Certificates of Origin, Health Certificates, Certificates of Free Sale, and other required documents.
Ensure all shipping documentation is accurate, complete, and compliant with international trade requirements.
Communicate shipment updates and proactively address delays, discrepancies, or operational issues.
Work closely with internal teams and external partners to ensure smooth shipment execution.
Maintain organized records of shipments, documentation, and freight-related communications.
Support continuous improvement of logistics processes and operational efficiency.
Manage multiple shipments simultaneously while meeting deadlines and maintaining attention to detail.

Experience coordinating international ocean and air freight shipments.
Knowledge of import/export processes and logistics operations.
Familiarity with export documentation and shipping compliance requirements.
Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple departments and external partners.
Ability to manage multiple shipments simultaneously while meeting deadlines.
High level of attention to detail and organization.
Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.

Previous experience in logistics, freight forwarding, supply chain, transportation, or international trade.
Understanding of Bills of Lading, Air Waybills, Certificates of Origin, and related export documentation.
Experience working with freight carriers, customs brokers, warehouses, and freight forwarders.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.
Ability to work independently while maintaining strong communication with leadership and team members.
English proficiency required.

Opportunity to work directly with executive leadership.

As a Senior Technical Procurement Specialist – PCBs / Electronics , you are responsible for the end-to-end procurement of printed circuit boards (PCBs) through our manufacturing partners (Contract Manufacturers, CMs). You work at the interface between Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production, translating technical requirements into clear supplier packages, negotiating costs and lead times, and ensuring that the right boards are available on time and at the required quality level.
This role is ideal for someone who understands how PCBs are actually manufactured (stack-ups, materials, tolerances, DFM) and enjoys the commercial and operational aspects of bringing products to life at scale.

s.h: What is your Day to Day Mission
s.t:
Own PCB procurement end-to-end – from RFQ and quote analysis through PO creation, order tracking, delivery, and closure.
Translate engineering needs into supplier-ready data – review BOMs, Gerbers, stackups, drawings, and specifications to ensure CMs have complete and correct information.
Manage contract manufacturers – build strong relationships, align on capabilities and capacity, and drive performance on cost, quality, lead time, and responsiveness, including on-site visits of contract manufacturers
Optimize cost and lead time – run competitive RFQs, analyze trade-offs (volume, lead time, technology level), and negotiate pricing and terms with CMs.
Mitigate supply and technical risks – monitor material availability (e.g. laminates, copper weights, finishes), propose alternates, and escalate issues before they become schedule slips.
Support NPI and engineering changes – coordinate production ramp-up, manage ECO impacts on PCB procurement, and ensure smooth transitions from prototype to volume.
Ensure quality and compliance – work closely with QA/engineering to address nonconformances, track supplier performance, and ensure boards meet required standards (e.g. IPC, customer specs).
Keep everything organized and visible – maintain accurate data in ERP/MRP and tracking tools, provide clear status updates, and keep stakeholders aligned on dates and risks.

s.h: What you bring to the team
s.t:
Technical background in electronics or PCBs – ability to read schematics, BOMs, and Gerber/ODB++ files; familiarity with PCB stackups, materials, finishes, and manufacturing constraints.
Experience in electronics/PCB procurement or supply chain – ideally working directly with PCB fabs and/or PCB assembly contract manufacturers.
Comfortable working with engineers – you can discuss layer counts, impedance, controlled tolerances, and DFM/DFT topics and translate that into supplier requirements.
Strong commercial and negotiation skills – able to compare quotes, build cost breakdowns, negotiate pricing and MOQs, and structure win–win agreements.
Data-driven and detail-oriented – you spot inconsistencies in BOMs/specs, track multiple orders in parallel, and use data (lead times, yields, costs) to drive decisions.
Tool-savvy – experience with Netsuit ERP/MRP systems and common engineering tools (e.g. Altium/KiCad/Cadence exports, Excel/Sheets for analysis, ticketing/project tools for tracking).
Collaborative communicator – clear written and verbal communication with suppliers and internal teams; able to summarize complex situations into actionable updates both in English and German.
Bias for execution – you’re proactive, take ownership of issues, and push to resolution when schedules and builds are at risk.
Familiarity with PLM and configuration management (ECR/ECO), supplier qualification, FAI (AS9102), and quality documentation.
Clear, concise communication and the ability to lead cross-functional reviews and drive decisions in a fast-moving environment.

The NPI Prototype Procurement Manager owns fast-turn prototype sourcing during new product development. When engineering needs a part quoted and built in days, not weeks, this role makes it happen, and makes sure the part we source for a prototype build doesn't quietly become a bad default for production.
This role reports to the Director of Supply Chain and works closely with engineering, our prototype contract manufacturers, and our production sourcing team. Prototype CMs are good at turning parts fast; they are not set up to decide which of those parts should become a real production supplier, or to catch when a rushed sourcing decision is costing us on markup or quality risk down the line. That decision needs a dedicated owner on our side.
We are building this role now because the gap is already showing up in real costs: parts moving slower than they should, and markups on prototype-CM-sourced parts that we're paying today without anyone tracking whether that's the right long-term call.
Scope
Fast-turn sourcing: for parts that are strategic, long-lead, or clearly headed toward production, you run the RFQ and sourcing decision directly rather than letting a prototype CM default-source it under time pressure.
Prototype-to-production tracking: for parts a prototype CM sources on our behalf, you track what was bought, from whom, and at what cost, and you flag early which of those should transition to a qualified production supplier instead of carrying forward by default.
Cost visibility: you own should-cost tracking on new parts as designs stabilize, flagging anything trending over target early enough to actually do something about it.
This role sits specifically in the handoff between early prototype builds and production. Production commodity strategy, supplier negotiation, and cost-out on qualified production parts stay with our sourcing team. Day-to-day material tracking and expediting once a part is in production stays with our materials team. This role owns the messy middle: prototype-stage sourcing decisions that determine what production inherits.
This role starts as an individual contributor working in close partnership with engineering.
Who this role is for
You have direct experience sourcing prototype and early-production parts in a hardware environment, working shoulder to shoulder with engineering while designs are still moving. You're comfortable quoting and placing an order on a part that might change again next week.
You think past the next build. When a prototype shop sources a part fast, you're the person asking whether that supplier, that price, and that quality level are good enough to carry into production, or whether it needs to change before it's too late to change cheaply.
You're comfortable working through and around a contract manufacturer's own sourcing team rather than owning a factory floor yourself. You know how to get a CM's buyer to move fast for you, and you know when to route around them and source directly.
You have a cost-conscious streak. You notice when a markup looks high and you're willing to do the work to find out if it's justified.
You are comfortable in early-stage environments where the playbook is still being written, and where this specific handoff between prototype and production sourcing hasn't had a dedicated owner before.
This role is not a fit for
You are looking to own production commodity strategy or long-term supplier negotiation. That sits with our sourcing team.
You are looking to own day-to-day material tracking and expediting once parts are in production. That sits with our materials team.
You need stable designs and a locked BOM to work effectively. This role lives in the period before that’s true.
You would find a startup operating tempo frustrating.

Prototype sourcing
Run quick-turn RFQs and place orders directly for strategic, long-lead, or clearly production-bound parts during prototype builds.
Partner with engineering embedded in design reviews and build planning, understanding what’s changing and what’s stabilizing.
Manage supplier relationships for quick-turn shops separate from our production supplier base.
Prototype-to-production handoff
Track every part sourced by a prototype CM on our behalf: supplier, cost, and whether it’s fit to carry forward.
Flag parts that should transition to a qualified production supplier early enough to make the change before it’s expensive.
Hand off qualified parts and supplier context cleanly to our production sourcing team, with a clear paper trail rather than tribal knowledge.
Cost visibility
Own should-cost tracking on new parts as designs stabilize, flagging cost overruns early.
Identify where prototype CM markups are worth the convenience and where a direct sourcing decision would save real money.
Cross-functional partnership
Partner with our production sourcing team on the handoff for parts moving from prototype to production.
Partner with our materials team on build timing and part availability during prototype phases.
Partner with engineering on design-for-sourcing input while parts are still changeable.

4+ years in procurement or sourcing supporting new product development in a hardware or industrial product environment.
Direct experience with fast-turn/quick-turn sourcing (rapid prototyping shops, quick-turn machining or fab, low-volume electronics).
Comfort working alongside a contract manufacturer’s own sourcing team rather than owning a factory floor directly.
Experience evaluating whether a prototype-sourced part or supplier is fit to carry into production.
Ability to operate independently and build process where none exists yet.

Experience in battery, energy storage, power electronics, or other hardware-adjacent categories.
Should-cost or cost estimation experience on early-stage or immature designs.
Experience transitioning parts from a prototype or contract manufacturer to a qualified production supplier.
Early-stage startup experience.

Zurich Instruments is a technology leader in advanced test and measurement instruments based on dynamic signal processing. Serving as the key interface between Planning, Suppliers, Manufacturing, and R&D, you will translate technical requirements into sourcing strategies, build strong supplier relationships, and resolve technical and logistical challenges to keep production on track.

Your contribution will be essential to delivering our high-tech instrumentation to customers worldwide.

Responsible for operational purchasing including quotation requests, purchase orders and order confirmations.
Monitoring of schedule dates and reporting critical delays to prevent material shortages.
First contact for quotation requests and purchasing for production, R&D and other departments.

Contributor to process improvements.
Support with New Product Development (NPD) activities.

Completed commercial or technical apprenticeship with further education in purchasing/business administration or engineering degree with relevant procurement experience.
Minimum 10 years of experience in procurement in a technical (ideally electronic) industry.
Solution oriented thinking, independent and conscientious working style, hands-on mentality.
Technically savvy with the ability to understand the high-level technical design, issues, and solutions of our products.
Structured way of working, strong negotiation skills, analytical and conceptual abilities.
Experience with ERP systems and procurement processes.
Fluent written and spoken German and English.
Excellent communication skills.
We offer a diverse work environment with an open and transparent company culture where personal development forms the basis of our success. This is Procurement at Lattice
Lattice’s Procurement Team builds value for the company through both supplier and stakeholder relationships and balanced agreements. As part of the accounting team, we place a large focus on risk mitigation and compliance in addition to the commercial elements of the deals we support. We are a small team with a huge impact on Lattice’s future success.
Contract details: This is a two-month contract role, fully remote, 3 days/week guaranteed with the potential for additional hours as needed. You’ll have the opportunity to gain hands-on experience with the full procurement lifecycle, procurement orchestration tools (P2P), and exposure to a high-performing tech organization.

You’ll be responsible for reviewing, scoping, negotiating, and executing procurement requests from intake through signature.
You’ll partner with cross-functional leaders, stakeholders, and department contacts from FP&A, Finance, IT, Security, Compliance, Privacy, and Legal to ensure our deals meet or exceed team requirements.
You’ll provide consultation before, during, and after deal cycles to our internal teams, ensuring that we purchase the right things and get exceptional value from our suppliers and partners.

3 years of experience with commercial negotiations, procurement initiatives, or complex vendor engagements.
A strong understanding of SaaS procurement, services agreements, and supplier relationships, along with hands-on experience using procurement orchestration tools, ideally Zip.
Strong attention to detail to ensure clean and accurate records within Lattice systems reflecting up-to-date deal statuses, vendor records, and intake reviews.
Clear, thoughtful communication skills, with the ability to adapt your approach based on audience and situation.

* Strong ERP skills; experience with Microsoft Dynamics / D365 is an asset
* Solid understanding of processes and enjoyment in working in a structured, organized way
* Confident communication skills and strong stakeholder-management capability
* Analytical, solution-driven and proactive working style

Supply Chain Manager
mylife Diabetes Care is a global medical technology company focused on integrated solutions for people with diabetes. As a growing company, we continue to develop our organization with a clear strategy, ambitious growth goals and plenty of room for personal responsibility.
To strengthen our Supply Chain team responsible for Consumables, we are looking for an experienced Supply Chain professional who takes ownership of assigned products and components and ensures reliable supply from planning to delivery.
In this role, you will work closely with Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), suppliers, affiliates and internal stakeholders to manage supply, align forecasts, follow up on open topics and ensure that issues are driven to resolution.
Supply Chain Manager \| 80 \- 100%
Ref. No. 283
Location: Burgdorf \| Hybrid
Your main tasks
Manage assigned products and components across the supply chain, from forecasting and procurement planning to material availability and market supply
Act as the day\-to\-day supply chain interface with CMOs, suppliers and internal stakeholders, ensuring reliable planning, delivery coordination and issue resolution
Prepare and align supplier forecasts based on demand, inventory requirements, supplier capacity and lead times, while monitoring open orders, delivery schedules, stock coverage and supply risks
Identify potential supply shortages or delays at an early stage, initiate appropriate operational countermeasures, and follow up on actions with internal and external stakeholders
Participate in regular planning, supply, transfer and coordination meetings with internal teams, affiliates, CMOs, suppliers and external partners
Coordinate supply chain activities related to product changes, launches, transfers, phase\-ins, phase\-outs and other lifecycle topics
Maintain and improve SAP master data, planning parameters, forecasts and supply chain\-relevant databases for allocated materials
Track defined supply chain KPIs, analyze deviations, prepare regular reporting and initiate or coordinate improvements where required
Ensure that supply chain activities are performed in line with applicable GMP requirements, SOPs, work instructions, inspection plans and relevant process documentation
Contribute to practical improvements in planning, purchasing, master data and supply chain processes within the assigned area
Your profile
Several years of hands\-on experience in supply chain operations, procurement planning, operational purchasing, material planning, supplier forecasting or a comparable role
Good practical understanding of procurement, material planning, inventory management, order management and supplier coordination
Experience working with CMOs, suppliers and external procurement partners across planning, purchasing and supply execution activities
Experience in a regulated medical technology, pharmaceutical or comparable environment is beneficial; familiarity with GMP\-related requirements is an advantage
Practical experience with SAP, particularly SD and MM, as well as confidence working with forecasts, inventory data, planning parameters, master data and KPIs
Ability to identify potential supply issues, assess priorities and coordinate appropriate actions with the relevant stakeholders
Structured, pragmatic and well\-organized working style, with the ability to manage multiple topics, deadlines and follow\-up activities in parallel
Hands\-on mentality with a proactive and reliable working style, focused on execution, timely completion and follow\-through until issues are resolved
Clear communication style, cross\-functional mindset and confidence working with internal teams, international suppliers, affiliates, CMOs and external partners
Fluent in English; German is considered a plus

Sound judgment on small samples. You know why "40 clicks, no conversions" is usually not a reason to pause anything, and you can explain what would change your mind.

You understand offline conversion imports. Why Google Ads and a client's booking system disagree, and which one you optimize against.
Call tracking experience, CallRail preferred. Every account here is graded on tracked phone calls, so the call data is the scoreboard, not a side report.
You already work with AI and you want more of it. This is not a culture question, it is the job. We use Claude and Claude Code every day and you would too. Not an engineer: someone who reaches for these tools by instinct and can say what they have actually built with them.

Willing to say "I do not know yet, let me check." Our worst outcomes have all come from confident wrong answers.

Job Description
Based at our office in Penrose, Auckland and reporting to our Procurement Manager, this high-impact role places you right at the core of our supply chain. As a Buyer, you’ll take full ownership of ingredient availability across our New Zealand operations for the Produce, PHF category, balancing speed, cost efficiency, and risk mitigation to keep our operations running seamlessly.
You’ll be the key connector across the business, collaborating daily with external suppliers alongside our Strategic Procurement, Production, Menu Planning, Warehouse, and Logistics teams. We are looking for a thoughtful, organized, and collaborative problem-solver who is excited to jump in, bring fresh ideas, and help build smarter end-to-end buying processes and tools as we continue to grow.
You will…
Supply Planning & Operational Execution: Own supply planning for the PHF category (fresh produce), including auditing purchase orders for accuracy, executing emergency POs, and managing stock-on-hand and ordering processes.
Supplier Performance & Governance: Lead Weekly, Monthly, and Quarterly Business Reviews with key suppliers. Track On-Time In-Full metrics, error rates, and quality issues to ensure high supplier performance and delivery precision.
Incident Resolution & SME Contact: Act as the Subject Matter Expert and primary operational contact for category product or supplier issues, resolving supply-related incidents before they impact production.
Inventory & Lifecycle Management: Balance forecasted demand with supply capacity to maintain optimal inventory. Implement buffer management to prevent shortages, lead SKU rationalization, and manage Stock Rundown Planning for phasing out ingredients.
Financial Integrity & Invoice Validation: Assist with cost reporting and resolve invoice discrepancies regarding price or quantity mismatches in a timely manner.

At Red Bull Switzerland, the Operations team makes sure our product is always in the right place, at the right time, in the right condition – and that our events and activations run like clockwork behind the scenes.
As Procurement Manager, you will take full ownership of establishing and shaping the Procurement function within Red Bull Switzerland. Reporting to the Head of Operations, you will drive transparency, unlock value, and enable smart, efficient sourcing across a wide range of categories, from logistics and media to events and promotional materials.
This is a highly visible role with strategic impact. You will act as a key business partner, collaborating across departments and with Global Procurement to embed best\-in\-class processes, challenge the status quo, and position Procurement as a true driver of business performance.

Strategic procurement
You will build and embed the Procurement function within the organisation, setting the foundation for long\-term success. This includes developing and implementing local procurement policies, processes, and governance in line with global standards.

You will define a clear procurement roadmap, create transparency across third\-party spend, and proactively identify opportunities for optimisation, efficiency, and value creation. As part of this journey, you will drive change management and position Procurement as a trusted and value\-adding function across the business.
Strategic Sourcing \& Supplier Management
You will take the lead on key sourcing initiatives, driving end\-to\-end procurement processes from strategy definition to contract finalisation. This includes shaping category strategies, identifying consolidation opportunities, and leading supplier negotiations to deliver the best value across pricing, quality, and risk.

You will establish strong, transparent relationships with key suppliers, implement performance management frameworks, and ensure sustainability requirements are embedded into all sourcing activities.
Stakeholder management \& Innovation
You will act as a strategic advisor to internal stakeholders, working closely with budget owners and department leads to align procurement strategies with business needs. Through strong collaboration and data\-driven insights, you will optimise spend and enhance decision\-making.

You will track and communicate procurement performance, ensuring clear visibility on KPIs, savings, and broader value contributions, while maintaining close alignment with Global Procurement and contributing to cross\-regional initiatives.

4\-5\+ years’ experience in indirect procurement (e.g. logistics, warehousing, fleet/travel, events, media, marketing or business services) with a strong track record in strategic sourcing and contract negotiations.

Fluent in German and English (written and spoken); comfortable in a fast\-paced, marketing\-driven environment and flexible to support key events when needed.

This is a remote position.
Senior Google Media Buyer
Reports to: Director of Performance Marketing

We are looking for an exceptional Senior Google Media Buyer to own and scale paid acquisition across the Google ecosystem, including Google Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen, Display, and Shopping campaigns.
Reporting directly to the Director of Performance Marketing, you will be a key hands-on executor within the performance team - responsible for campaign strategy, account structure, optimisation, testing, reporting, and scaling performance across Google Ads.
This is not a coordination role.
We are looking for someone who lives inside Google Ads. Someone who can diagnose underperformance at a granular level, uncover growth opportunities through data, build testing frameworks, and drive measurable improvements to CPA, ROAS, lead quality, and revenue.
If your idea of Google Ads management is adjusting bids and pulling weekly reports, this role is not for you.

Own campaign execution across Google Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Demand Gen, Display, and Shopping.
Manage and optimise substantial Google Ads budgets with a focus on efficiency, profitability, and growth.
Develop and execute structured testing roadmaps across keywords, audiences, bidding strategies, ad copy, landing pages, and campaign structures.
Analyse campaign performance to identify trends, diagnose issues, and uncover scaling opportunities.
Improve CPA, ROAS, conversion rates, lead quality, and customer acquisition efficiency.
Build and maintain clear reporting dashboards using Google Ads, GA4, Looker Studio, and other reporting tools.
Work closely with the Director of Performance Marketing on budget allocation, forecasting, and growth strategy.
Partner with Creative, CRO, and Data teams to improve ad performance and landing page conversion rates.
Stay ahead of Google Ads platform updates, automation developments, and emerging best practices.

We believe the future of paid acquisition will be increasingly driven by AI, automation, and intelligent decision-making systems.
As a Senior Google Media Buyer, you will be expected to actively leverage Google's AI-powered solutions, including Smart Bidding, Performance Max, audience signals, predictive audiences, and AI-assisted reporting workflows.
You will work alongside our performance team and in-house developer to identify opportunities where automation can improve efficiency, accelerate testing, and enhance campaign performance.
Prior experience building AI agents is not required, but you must be curious, adaptable, and genuinely excited about how AI is transforming Google Ads and performance marketing.

3-6 years of hands-on Google Ads experience.
Proven experience managing significant Google Ads budgets.
Deep expertise across Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Shopping, Display, and Demand Gen campaigns.
Strong understanding of GA4, Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking, attribution, enhanced conversions, and offline conversion imports.
Demonstrated ability to improve ROAS and reduce CPA through structured testing and optimisation.
Advanced analytical skills with proficiency in Google Ads reporting, Looker Studio, spreadsheets, and performance analysis.
Strong understanding of keyword strategy, search intent, audience segmentation, and account architecture.
Attention to detail with a bias toward ownership, initiative, and fast iteration.
Clear communicator who can translate complex performance data into actionable business insights.
Most importantly, you must genuinely enjoy the craft. We want someone who finds account diagnostics, optimisation, and scaling opportunities exciting - someone who notices what others miss and takes ownership of results.

This is an opportunity to join one of the most analytically rigorous performance marketing teams in the region.
You will have real ownership over significant Google Ads budgets, direct access to senior leadership, and the resources to experiment, iterate, and grow quickly.
You will be joining a team that takes performance marketing seriously - investing in people, technology, and systems to build a genuine competitive advantage through paid acquisition.
